points.text: Donald Trump made a final appeal to voters at the Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool before the midterm elections; the pool was closed for restoration.
Belgian Prime Minister Bart De Wever offered his resignation after coalition parties failed to agree on a budget; King Philippe has not accepted it.
The UN peacekeeping mission in Western Sahara ended after the Security Council did not renew its mandate, ending operations that began in 1991.
Authorities in Ukraine and Russia reported cyberattacks sending false emergency alerts, while European supermarkets reported suspected attacks altering freezer and refrigerator controls.
A Learjet crash in Florida killed nine people, including 20-year-old co-pilot Nathalia Gadelha; the pilot had reported icing and turbulence before declaring an emergency.
